en: Colorized vintage view of a lake surrounded by low, arid hills. In the foreground is sparse vegetation and a person on horseback on a dirt slope. Across the center is a calm body of water, and behind it rolling hills under a light sky. At the top left, printed text reads "Laguna de Alalay, Cochabamba." A small number "3686" appears in the bottom right corner, suggesting a catalog or series number.
